messages:
dave: Heads-up: strict fncall schema gate rolled to canary and console is showing ~0.75% hard rejects. Most traces point to partner adapters returning arrays or nulls where we expect objects. Need a short mitigation plan.

lina: Can you paste a failing sample?

dave: From logs:```json
{"fn":"fetch_profile","out":[{"uid":"u123"}],"meta":{"partner":"partner-alpha"}}
```
We expect `out` -> `{user:{id:int,name:string}}`.

priya: Validator owner here. We flipped to reject to detect regressions but didn't realize the partner mix. Were reject events being sampled? We don't want noisy pagers.

mike: Ops: sampling was 100% for canary so we could measure. Pager is getting noisy. Short-term options: (1) revert to permissive; (2) switch to warn-mode (log + 200); (3) route flagged partners to a compat variant. (2) seems least disruptive.

lina: +1 for warn-mode. Keep the metric fidelity but avoid customer 4xxs. Also request we tag telemetry by partner and route_id so console can show partner skew.

priya: I'll push a hotfix to set validator_mode = "warn" for the canary route. Implementation plan: increment metric `fncall.schema_warns` with tags {route_id, partner, model}; add header `X-Redwood-Fncall: validation=warn`; and set `tool_passthrough: true` so the runtime forwards original tool output.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: warn toggle requested by @priya. CI quick checks passed. ETA ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

dave: Also: capture redacted samples of warn events to s3://fncall/debug-samples/ with partner+route tags (1% sample). Without samples triage is slow.

priya: Will add a sampling hook that strips emails/PII and stores sample with `ingest_origin:canary_warn`. That tag will let us filter offline replays so we don't double-count.

mike: Long-term: build a runtime `compat_quarantine` where ops can mark partner ids as `compat-v1` and runtime routes them to `fn-compat-v1` which uses permissive parsing and an adapter shim. That avoids global validator changes. Need a small design doc.

lina: Console/product ask: add a dashboard tile that splits `schema_warns` by partner and route_id and highlights canary slices. Current model-only view masks partner concentration.

dave: Also check quota/billing: make sure warns are not billed as errors or retried. Add metric tag `ingest_origin` and ensure billing pipeline ignores canary_warn metrics for chargeback.

priya: Hotfix merged; canary set to warn-mode. Telemetry showing `fncall.schema_warns` incrementing but no client 4xxs. Samples hook active.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary change completed. :white_check_mark:

mike: I'll draft the quarantine design and a minimal coercion shim (handle single-element array -> object, null -> empty object, numeric string -> int) and gate it behind `compat_mode` per-route. Also propose an SDK helper for partners to run local validation.

lina: I'll add the dashboard panel (beta) and wire the sample link to the panel.

dave: Initial sample analysis shows top offenders: partner-alpha, legacy-partner, sync-oldsvc. I'm looping in account owners.

priya: Will produce a short incident note with counts and queries tomorrow. Follow-ups: mike -> design doc for quarantine+shim; lina -> dashboard tile + sample links; dave -> partner outreach list. Re-evaluate after 24h. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
